title: Electronics 1
objectives:
The main purpose of this course is to study the current equations, equivalent
circuit of transistors, BJT transistor and its applications, and characteristics of
current versus voltage.
syllabus:
- N-type and P-type semiconductors. Current and voltage equations in
diode.
- Equivalent circuits for diodes.
- Diode circuits: half-wave and full-wave rectifiers, Clipper circuits, and
Clamp circuits.
- Transistor: Biasing, quiescent point, small signal and low-frequency
equivalent circuits, application as an amplifier, and application as a
switch.
- JFET transistors: Biasing, equivalent circuits, application as an amplifier,
application as a switch, an introduction to D-Mode and E-Mode MOS
transistors
- 4-layer diodes
textbooks:
1. Robert W. Lucky, "The First Book of Electronics", 2009.
2. Ian Sinclair, John Dunton, "Practical Electronics Handbook", 2007.
